mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) above 2.5% YoY signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If CPIAUCSL YoY > 2.5% does not correlate with negative 20-day forward returns in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5% in one month signals economic weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If UNRATE rises > 0.5% in 1 month does not correlate with negative 5-day forward returns in > 70% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in Real Final Sales (RSAFS) over three consecutive months signals weakening consumer demand, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If RSAFS declines for 3 consecutive months does not correlate with negative 60-day forward returns in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in Industrial Production Index (INDPRO) by more than 1% in one month signals strengthening supply-side activity, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If INDPRO rises > 1% in 1 month does not correlate with positive 20-day forward returns in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decrease in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) over three consecutive months signals an easing monetary policy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If FEDFUNDS decreases over three consecutive months does not correlate with positive 60-day forward returns in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of rising unemployment rate (UNRATE) and falling nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) signals economic weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If UNRATE rises and PAYEMS falls does not correlate with negative 20-day forward returns in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp decline in housing starts (HOUST) combined with a rise in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) signals a weakening economy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If HOUST declines and UNRATE rises does not correlate with negative 60-day forward returns in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: During a late-cycle expansion, a rise in Industrial Production Index (INDPRO) coupled with a stable or decreasing unemployment rate (UNRATE) signals robust economic activity, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO rises and UNRATE stable or falls
failure_condition: If INDPRO rises and UNRATE is stable or falls does not correlate with positive 20-day forward returns in > 60% of triggered instances during late-cycle expansions.
